title: Everyone Overlooks This Simple Side Hustle
channel: Chris Koerner on The Koerner Office Podcast
promo_conflict: Don describes his own business and gives its website and Instagram handle at the close, creating a promotional incentive.

stated_problem.quote: And so people overlook it like I'm I'm too good for that.

idea.name: Fresh squeezed lemonade stand and catering
idea.one_liner: Sells fresh squeezed lemonade at farmers markets and caters corporate, family and community events.
idea.customer: Farmers market customers and event organizers, including corporate groups, homeowners associations and schools.
idea.offer: Fresh squeezed lemonade by the cup, plus pre-batched or served lemonade catering.
idea.revenue_model: Drink sales at markets and partner venues, plus event catering fees.

acquisition_channels.details: Don says he is working on SEO for catering.
They promote catering at their markets and push graduation events.
Don says his personal network and friends have brought in business.
They work with concession companies and partner venues.
They also get inquiries through their website.

ideas.delivery: The family and staff prepare lemons and syrup at a warehouse, then serve drinks at market booths, a converted trailer and catered events. Some catering is pre-batched.
ideas.other_uk_rules: A UK version would need to account for food business registration, hygiene, allergen information and safe temperature control. UK GDPR applies to customer and enquiry data; child employment rules matter if children staff the business.

idea.name: Rent out the lemonade cart
idea.one_liner: Rents the cart to event hosts and event-service companies for a fixed fee, with optional lemonade.
idea.customer: People hosting weddings or other events, bartending companies and corporate event organizers.
idea.offer: A lemonade cart rental, dropped off at the venue; the renter or venue staff can operate it.
idea.revenue_model: Fixed rental fee, with an additional delivery and pickup fee in standard bookings.

key_quotes.quote: So, we rent to entrepreneurs or to people that have an event.
Just straight up rental for four. I drop it off.
No, we just kind of, you know, I get a lot of it too through between what I post on Facebook Marketplace and my my network, you know, on on my friends.

claims.quote: So, we've already kind of booked like several that cuz we sell We'll do that for $500.

claims.claim: The rental is described as 'for four'; the unit is not stated in that line.
claims.quote: Just straight up rental for four.

claims.claim: The direct rental price is also stated as $500; a nearby exchange describes the rental as being for a day.
claims.quote: That's what you charge direct $500.

claims.claim: Standard delivery and pickup cost an additional $250.
claims.quote: But normally there's a $250 like delivery and pickup fee along with that as well.

acquisition_channels.details: Don posts the rentals on Facebook Marketplace.
He also gets rental inquiries through his personal network and friends.
The business website also brings rental inquiries.

ideas.delivery: Don drops off the cart at the venue; the event host or its bartending company can use it without Don staffing it.
ideas.other_uk_rules: UK GDPR applies to rental enquiries. Consumer Rights Act and distance-selling requirements may apply to consumer bookings; clear hire terms, liability cover and venue permission are relevant.
